info.name: SPU SmartQueue API Tests
info.description: Automated API test suite for the SPU SmartQueue system (NADV 744 Group Assignment). Organized to mirror the OpenAPI spec: auth, departments, tickets, staff, reports, users. Run order matters within folders due to shared state (tokens, IDs) via environment variables. Recommended run order: Root -> Auth -> Departments -> Tickets -> Staff -> Reports -> Users.

item.name: 07 - Session Teardown
item.description: Logout, run LAST. This backend deletes ALL of a user's tokens on logout (not just the current session's), so nothing earlier in the run can depend on student_token after this point.

request.description: MUST run last. Confirmed backend behaviour: LogoutView does Token.objects.filter(user=request.user).delete() -- this deletes every token for the user, so the API does not support multiple concurrent sessions per account. Running this earlier breaks every subsequent request that relies on student_token.

exec: pm.test("Token is invalidated after logout", function () {
// Sanity note: this backend deletes ALL tokens for the user on logout,
// not just this session's token. Documented finding for the report.
